en.summary: Oral thrush causes white patches in the mouth that can be wiped leaving red areas, with soreness. NHS: see a pharmacist/GP — antifungal gel/drops may be advised. Check inhaler technique/spacers if on steroid inhalers. Infants and immunocompromised need clinical advice. No inventing systemic antifungal doses.
seeDoctorIf: Infant with feeding difficulty and white mouth patches
Immunocompromised or diabetes with oral thrush
doNot: Do not invent oral antifungal tablet regimens
Do not ignore thrush with swallowing pain (possible oesophageal involvement — clinical review)

fr.summary: Le muguet buccal forme des plaques blanches. Pharmacien/médecin pour antifongique local. Technique d'inhalateur à vérifier. Pas d'antifongiques systémiques inventés.

he.summary: פטרייה בפה: כתמים לבנים. רוקח/רופא לתכשיר מקומי. לבדוק טכניקת משאף סטרואידים. אין אנטי־פטרייתי מערכתי מומצא.

ru.summary: Молочница во рту: белые пятна. Фармацевт/врач за местным противогрибковым. Проверить технику ингалятора. Системные дозы не выдумывать.
